name: EKS Cluster Create or Delete
description: An EKS cluster is the control plane for Kubernetes in AWS. Creating a cluster the attacker controls gives them a place to run workloads. Deleting a production cluster takes the whole application stack down. Neither of those is the same as adding a backdoor user to an existing cluster. Creation is provisioning; deletion is impact. Both should be rare outside platform-engineering pipelines. If a cluster appears or disappears without a ticket, assume hostile change until proven otherwise.
mitigations: Rotate credentials if the actor is compromised
